3_4_Sit-Up: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Raise your torso about three quarters of the full range, without sitting all the way up.
Lower with control without fully resting your back.
Ab_Crunch_Machine: Sit in the machine and hold the handles or rest your chest on the pad.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Advanced_Kettlebell_Windmill: Press a kettlebell overhead with a straight arm, feet pointing to the opposite side.
Keeping your eyes on it, push your hips towards the side of the arm holding it and lower your other hand to the floor.
Come back up with the arm always vertical. It requires good mobility: use a light weight.
Air_Bike: Lie on your back with your hands by your temples and your legs raised.
Bring one elbow towards the opposite knee while straightening the other leg.
Alternate sides in a pedalling motion.
Alternate_Heel_Touchers: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Lean to one side until your hand touches your heel.
Alternate sides without resting your shoulders.
Barbell_Ab_Rollout: Kneel on the floor with a loaded barbell in front of you, gripped shoulder-width apart.
Roll the bar forward, extending your body as far as you can without letting your lower back sag.
Pull back with your abs. Start with short ranges.
Barbell_Rollout_from_Bench: Kneel on a bench with a loaded barbell on the floor in front of you.
Roll the bar forward, extending your body.
Pull back with your abs without arching your back.
Barbell_Side_Bend: Stand with the bar across your upper back.
Bend your torso to one side without twisting it.
Return to the centre and repeat to the other side.
Bent-Knee_Hip_Raise: Lie on your back with your knees bent and legs raised, arms by your sides.
Lift your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Bottoms_Up: Lie on your back with your legs straight up towards the ceiling.
Lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet upwards.
Butt-Ups: Raise your hips towards the ceiling to form an inverted V.
Return to the plank with control.
Cable_Reverse_Crunch: Lie on your back facing a low pulley with the ankle strap or rope hooked to your feet.
Bring your knees towards your chest, lifting your hips off the floor.
Cable_Russian_Twists: Sit side-on to a low pulley holding the handle with both hands, torso leaning back slightly.
Rotate your torso, taking the handle to the opposite side.
Return with control and switch sides.
Cable_Seated_Crunch: Sit on a bench with your back to a high pulley, holding the rope by your head.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Cocoons: Lie on your back with your arms stretched behind your head and your legs straight.
Tuck your body, bringing your knees to your chest while your arms reach towards your knees.
Cross-Body_Crunch: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands by your temples.
Raise your torso, bringing one elbow towards the opposite knee.
Crunch_-_Hands_Overhead: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms stretched overhead.
Lift your shoulders off the floor, keeping your arms by your ears.
Crunch_-_Legs_On_Exercise_Ball: Lie on your back with your calves on an exercise ball.
Lift your shoulders off the floor by contracting your abs.
Decline_Crunch: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Lift your shoulders off the bench, curling your torso.
Decline_Oblique_Crunch: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Raise your torso while rotating to bring one elbow towards the opposite knee.
Decline_Reverse_Crunch: Lie on a decline bench with your head at the high end, holding the bench with your hands.
Bring your knees towards your chest, lifting your hips.
Double_Kettlebell_Windmill: Hold one kettlebell overhead with a straight arm and another hanging in the other hand.
Looking at the top one, push your hips towards its side and lower the other kettlebell towards the floor.
Come back up. Advanced exercise: master the single windmill first.
Dumbbell_Side_Bend: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand and the other hand on your waist.
Bend your torso towards the dumbbell side and return to the centre by contracting the opposite side.
Do all the reps and switch sides.
Elbow_to_Knee: Lie on your back with your hands by your temples and your legs raised.
Raise your torso, bringing one elbow towards the opposite knee.
Flat_Bench_Leg_Pull-In: Lie on your back on a flat bench, holding it with your hands, legs straight.
Bring your knees towards your chest.
Straighten your legs again without resting them.
Flat_Bench_Lying_Leg_Raise: Lie on your back on a flat bench, holding it with your hands.
Raise your straight legs until they are vertical.
Lower them with control without arching your back.
Frog_Sit-Ups: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and your knees apart.
Raise your torso towards your knees.
Gorilla_Chin_Crunch: Hang from the bar with an underhand grip.
Do a chin-up while bringing your knees towards your chest.
Lower with control, straightening your legs and arms.
Jackknife_Sit-Up: Lie on your back with your arms and legs straight.
Raise your torso and straight legs at the same time until your hands touch your feet.
Janda_Sit-Up: Lie on your back with your knees bent and press your heels into the floor.
Keeping that pressure, raise your torso slowly.
Lower with control. This reduces the help from the hip flexors.
Kettlebell_Figure_8: Stand in a half squat with a kettlebell in one hand.
Pass it between your legs to the other hand, tracing a figure eight around them.
Kettlebell_Pass_Between_The_Legs: Stand in a half squat with a kettlebell in one hand.
Pass it between your legs to the other hand and back again.
Keep your back straight and a steady rhythm.
Kneeling_Cable_Crunch_With_Alternating_O: Kneel facing a high pulley with the rope by your head.
Curl your torso, bringing your elbows towards one knee and then the other.
Landmine_180s: Set one end of the bar in a corner and hold the other with your arms straight in front of you.
Rotate your torso, sweeping the bar in an arc towards one hip and then the other.
Keep your abs tight and your feet planted.
Leg_Pull-In: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you and your straight legs raised.
Bring your knees towards your chest, leaning your torso slightly.
Straighten your legs again without resting them.
Oblique_Crunches: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your top hand by your temple.
Raise your torso towards your hip by contracting your side.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Oblique_Crunches_-_On_The_Floor: Lie on your back with your knees bent and dropped to one side.
Lift your shoulders off the floor by contracting your abs.
Lower with control and switch sides.
One-Arm_High-Pulley_Cable_Side_Bends: Standing side-on to a high pulley, grab the handle with the nearer hand.
Bend your torso to the opposite side, pulling the cable.
Return with control and switch sides.
Pallof_Press: Standing side-on to a pulley at chest height, hold the handle with both hands against your chest.
Press your arms straight out in front without letting the cable rotate your torso.
Return with control and switch sides.
Pallof_Press_With_Rotation: Standing side-on to a pulley at chest height, hold the handle with both hands and your arms straight.
Rotate your torso away from the pulley and return with control.
Reverse_Crunch: Lie on your back with your bent knees raised and your arms by your sides.
Bring your knees towards your chest, lifting your hips off the floor.
Rope_Crunch: Kneel facing a high pulley with the rope by your head.
Curl your torso, bringing your elbows towards your thighs.
Seated_Barbell_Twist: Sit on a bench with an unloaded bar across your upper back.
Rotate your torso from side to side with control, without moving your hips.
Seated_Flat_Bench_Leg_Pull-In: Sit on the edge of a bench holding it, with your legs straight and your torso leaning back.
Bring your knees towards your chest.
Seated_Leg_Tucks: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you and your straight legs raised.
Bring your knees towards your chest while bringing your torso closer.
Side_Jackknife: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your top hand by your temple.
Raise your torso and top leg at the same time by contracting your side.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Sit-Up: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and hands on your chest.
Raise your torso until you are sitting up.
Smith_Machine_Hip_Raise: Lie on your back under the Smith machine bar with your feet against it and your legs vertical.
Push the bar up by lifting your hips with your abs.
Spell_Caster: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand beside one hip.
Rotate your torso and sweep the dumbbells in an arc to the other side at chest height.
Come back and repeat. Switch sides.
Spider_Crawl: Walk forward with your hands while bringing one knee towards the elbow on the same side.
Alternate sides, moving forward with your body low.
Standing_Cable_Lift: Standing side-on to a low pulley, hold the handle with both hands by your hip.
Pull diagonally upwards, across your body, to above the opposite shoulder.
Return with control and switch sides.
Standing_Cable_Wood_Chop: Standing side-on to a high pulley, hold the handle with both hands above your shoulder.
Pull diagonally down to the opposite hip, rotating your torso.
Return with control and switch sides.
Standing_Rope_Crunch: With your back to a high pulley, hold the rope by your head.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Tuck_Crunch: Lie on your back with your bent knees raised and your hands by your temples.
Lift your shoulders, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Isometric_Neck_Exercise_-_Front_And_Back: Sitting or standing, place your hands on your forehead.
Push your head against your hands without moving it and hold for a few seconds.
Repeat with your hands behind your head. Do it gently.
Isometric_Neck_Exercise_-_Sides: Sitting or standing, place one hand on the side of your head.
Push your head against your hand without moving it and hold for a few seconds.
